story.text: Bingley calls again and again. Mrs. Bennet keeps finding excuses to leave him alone with Jane, and {WINKS} at her other daughters to follow. At last Elizabeth walks in to find them standing {TOGETHER} by the fire. Bingley has {PROPOSED}! Jane is the {HAPPIEST} creature in the {WORLD}, and Mr. Bennet says they are so {GENEROUS} that they will always {EXCEED} their income.
story.caption: She perceived her sister and Bingley standing together
